name: org-postgresql-wire
description: org-postgresql-wire -- transitive npm dep of kotoba-lang/arrangement (materialize target, via multiformats.core's @noble/hashes/sha2.js use) needed to load arrangement.core (pulled in transitively via kotobase-query) under nbb. Mirrors kotobase-query's own package.json note verbatim: io-multiformats' own package.json also declares a "hashes": "2.0.1" dependency, but nothing in its source actually requires the npm "hashes" package and no matching npm registry version exists -- that entry is vestigial/broken upstream and deliberately NOT mirrored here.
